package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestZZProxyBalancerWithNoTargetsRandom(t *testing.T) {
	rb := NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rb.Next(nil))
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rb))
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)
}

func TestZZProxyBalancerWithNoTargetsRoundRobin(t *testing.T) {
	rrb := NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rrb.Next(nil))
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rrb))
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)
}

func TestZZProxyBalancerRemovedAllTargets(t *testing.T) {
	rb := NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	assert.True(t, rb.AddTarget(&ProxyTarget{Name: "t"}))
	assert.True(t, rb.RemoveTarget("t"))
	e := echo.New()
	e.Use(Proxy(rb))
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, rec.Code)
}
EOF

Context#Scheme() returned whatever value was in X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-Protocol / X-Url-Scheme, so an invalid/spoofed value was reported as the scheme (violating the documented contract "Scheme returns the HTTP protocol scheme, `http` or `https`"). It now ignores any value that is not `http`/`https` and falls through to the next header, ending at `http`. Verified with a local table test including the two named subtests; the full existing suite still passes.

Request #2 (router.go): fixed. Router#Find set ctx.path to the *request* path before searching, so a request with no routable path still reported a registered-path (c.Path() returned the request path) even though no route matched. Find now only sets the path from the matched node (currentNode.ppath), so a non-routable request reports an empty path and NotFoundHandler. Verified: full existing suite still passes (I also fuzzed Find against a reference matcher for panics/hangs/wrong matches).
Request #4 (binder.go): a subagent is fixing bindDataToMap so it can bind into map[string][]string; I'm verifying the result. ETA ~4 min.
Request #5 (group.go): a subagent is fixing the same-path/multiple-groups middleware clobbering; I'm verifying the result. ETA ~4 min.
Request #6 (middleware/compress.go): a subagent is fixing the empty-body (gzip) case; I'm verifying the result. ETA ~4 min.
